name: XPlayer NodeDistributePlus permissionless DynamicBurnPool drains the XPL/USDT pair
summary: XPL.DynamicBurnPool burns XPL from the XPL/USDT pair and syncs it, callable by the NodeDistributePlus proxy, whose DynamicBurnPool(date, amount) forwarded any caller's request within the day's burn cap. The attacker bought nearly all pair XPL with flash-loaned USDT, burned the remaining cap from the pair, and sold a few XPL back for all pair USDT.
notes: The reset is the upgradeTo selecting the NodeDistributePlus implementation with the unrestricted DynamicBurnPool. XPL's nodeShareAddress grant and the burn cap were set earlier; the protocol keeper, calling about every 8,000 blocks, was the only other caller.

Loss is the pair's gross USDT depletion; flash-lender fees are not subtracted. The pair's XPL went to the protocol's marketing distributor and DEAD in the same swaps and is the same liquidity, so it is not added.
